semantic_reason: PR fixes existing incorrect reordering behavior: Styler was moving @before_compile/@after_compile/@after_verify module attributes away from `use` directives, breaking compile callback ordering. The change groups these callback attributes with `use` directives in ModuleDirectives to preserve their relative ordering, addressing reported issue #120. This corrects a defect in existing behavior rather than introducing new functionality.
